messages.author: 909ff578d0e714f8
messages.subject: Sparse matrix inversion
parts:
Hi everyone,

I was wondering if there is a forum (somewhere online) dedicated to the Matrix package? I am looking for help regarding inversion of a sparse p.d. matrix (specifically, I need help on methods for the CHMfactor class of (sparse) matrices).

Thank you very much,

Asaf
